name: AXL
summary: GTM platform for AI-product founders: pages, quizzes, webinars, CRM, AI calls and 1,200+ actions via MCP.
description: AXL is an all-in-one go-to-market system that combines landing pages, quizzes, webinars, courses, video hosting, email, chat, CRM, telephony and AI calls, so each interaction adds to the lead record. It scores leads with a model the company says was trained on 1M deals and 300+ signals, and it exposes lead context plus 1,200+ sales and marketing actions to ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor via MCP.
